title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative
Location: Stratford-upon-Avon
Salary: Starting from £28,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm

Company Overview
Operating within the technology and data solutions sector, this business helps organisations access specialist solutions that support their commercial objectives. With a focus on business growth, customer relationships and collaborative partnerships, the company offers a supportive environment where individuals can develop their sales expertise and contribute to long-term success.
About the Role
An exciting opportunity is available for a motivated Sales Development Representative to join a growing team in the cybersecurity and data protection sector. This office-based role in Stratford-upon-Avon focuses on generating new business across a designated UK territory, using telephone, email and LinkedIn to engage prospective customers. You ll help identify sales opportunities, support customer relationships and develop your knowledge of SaaS solutions and IT infrastructure, with ongoing training and support from an experienced team.

- Support lead generation campaigns linked to vendor partnerships and marketing initiatives.

- Keep up to date with new and emerging technologies within the technology sector.

Education & Skills Required
- Previous experience in sales or a customer-facing role is beneficial.
- Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage potential customers by phone, email and LinkedIn.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Outlook and Excel; CRM experience is desirable.
- Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and good time management.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach with an interest in technology and generating new business.
- A positive team player with a willingness to learn, develop new skills and embrace ongoing training.
- An interest in technology solutions, B2 B sales or vendor partnerships would be beneficial.

title: Customer Account Manager
description:
Customer Account Manager

Stratford-upon-Avon

Hybrid Role

£26,800

About the Company:

A leading UK-based Field Services company, specialising in providing external field agency solutions primarily to the utilities sector, is seeking a Customer Account Manager/Debt Resolution Officer. With its Head Office located in Stratford-upon-Avon, the company is known for delivering excellent service with a customer-centric approach.

The Role:

The Customer Account Manager/Debt Resolution Officer will be responsible for managing customer accounts referred by clients. This position involves working with customers primarily those in arrears to find affordable and sustainable repayment solutions. The role requires exceptional communication skills to engage with customers via phone and written correspondence, ensuring timely and fair resolutions.

Key Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound and outbound calls to discuss and resolve customer accounts.
- Negotiate payment arrangements that suit customer needs and comply with company processes.
- Offer excellent customer service while collecting payments and setting up payment plans.
- Address metering issues, occupancy updates, dispute registrations, and highlight household vulnerabilities.
- Liaise with Field Representatives and Clients to ensure accurate and efficient account management.
- Maintain clear and professional account records on company and client systems.
- Identify and record any safety concerns or vulnerabilities encountered.
- Provide support and guidance to field agents during customer visits.
- Ensure adherence to industry regulations and company quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:
- Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal).
- Confidence in handling challenging conversations with professionalism and empathy.
- Previous experience in debt negotiation, collections, or customer service is desirable but not essential.
- Strong IT and accurate keyboard skills.
- Attention to detail and the ability to spot and rectify errors efficiently.
- Results-driven attitude with excellent workload management abilities.
- Experience in the utilities industry is a plus, though not required.

Why Join This Team:
- Hybrid working model offering flexibility and work-life balance.
- Supportive team environment with opportunities for professional development.
- A role where empathy and problem-solving skills make a real impact.
